prompt: Add dark mode to page.html. It should follow the system setting by default, have an accessible toggle that remembers the user's choice, and avoid a flash of the wrong theme on load. Edit page.html in place.

checks.label: toggle has accessible state or name

rubric: Dark theme uses elevated, slightly lighter surfaces for cards rather than a flat single color
Brand orange is adapted (not glaring) in dark mode and text stays comfortably readable
The toggle is easy to find and its current state is visually clear
